StateTree.Comment: NonCombat subtree for Rogue bots in dungeon and raid instances (run by STAI_NonCombat_Rogue.xml)

Task.Comment: the rooms (InstanceSubsystem stages) of the bot and its master: stage, masterStage, masterStageCleared, pathBlocked, stagePosition, stagePositionFar, onStageBlocked, onStageCleared, onStagePositionFar

the player the bot follows in its group (its master while in the group, else the group leader, a human or a bot; none while solo): leader, leaderFar, location, onLeaderFar while it is beyond follow range
health / mana of the bot: healthPct, onHealthChanged / manaPct, onManaChanged

Task.name: Position Yourself
Task.Comment: movement goals (MovementGoal_GlobalTask, the highest wanted one drives the bot): the bot's point in the master's room (its rtsc / entrance override, else the room's position; the reason says which), reached at it, while the way is open

Task.name: Follow Leader
Task.Comment: after the leader (a path across dungeon portals), reached within follow range; solo bots have no leader: not while the master is in a room that is not cleared or between rooms, not through such a room, not with a point for the bot in the master's room

State.name: Eat and Drink
State.Comment: eating and drinking while the bot stands (its movement goal "reached"); moving again leaves the node

Task.Comment: placeholder until the new AI exists: waits forever, leaves only through a transition
